record.question: India's first ever insurance cover for individual victims of cyber crime is being introduced by
record.explanation: Answer C: Bajaj Allianz. Bajaj Allianz’s 2019 annual report advertises its Individual Cyber Safe Insurance Policy, matching the individual cyber-insurance product asked about; option (c), index 2. Reference: https://www.bajajgeneralinsurance.com/download-documents/annual-report/Annual-Report-2019.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
